blocks.heading: AI Behind a Mechanical Engineering Answer
Practice Rounds Before the Interview
rows: A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing.
Say it aloud under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes. Field check: plain and correct.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on core vs non-core.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: Keep extra mechanical course spending near 10 percent of your education budget and treat 20 percent as a caution. Illustration, not a real fee: from 4 lakh, about 40,000 goes to CAD or automation courses and the rest stays for living costs and parts.
